_what: Readings made by a person for sentences no strict pattern in build_fishing.py could sort. The key is the guidebook's sentence, word for word; if UDWR changes a word the build fails and points here. Each reading says why a pattern would not do. 'fx' is the list of effects, in the same form the patterns produce.

Limit 2 cutthroat or tiger trout (a comb.why: One bullet holding a limit, two size rules and a release rule. Panguitch Lake tributaries, page 37.

At all other times of the year, there is.why: Pond at Poulter Preserve, page 38. 'All other times' is the rest of the year after the bullet above it, which runs from 6 a.m. on the second Saturday of September through the third Saturday in May. So this one runs from the day after the third Saturday in May until 6 a.m. on the second Saturday of September. The dates are not in the sentence itself, hence w_by_hand.

Spanish Oaks Reservoir and Manila Creek.why: A note printed inside the Utah County list of community waters, page 31. It closes two named ponds, not the whole list, and the span runs over the new year.
